titleEn: Minimum Weighted Subgraph With the Required Paths
title: 得到要求路径的最小带权子图
summary: 有向带权图中选最小权边集，使 src1 和 src2 都能到达 dest，返回最小权重和或负一。
insight: 两条路径可在某个汇合点 meeting 后共享到 dest 的后缀。分别求 src1、src2 到各点的最短路，并在反图上从 dest 求各点到 dest 的最短路；枚举汇合点求三段距离和。
pitfalls: 共享边只计一次由汇合模型处理
距离使用 long 且不可达点跳过

solutions.title: 三次 Dijkstra 枚举汇合点
solutions.idea: 把最优子图分解成两条前缀与一条共享后缀。
steps: 枚举 node，三距离均有限时最小化 d1[node]+d2[node]+toDest[node]

code.java: class Solution { long[] dijkstra(int start,List<long[]>[] graph){long[] distance=new long[graph.length];Arrays.fill(distance,Long.MAX_VALUE);distance[start]=0;PriorityQueue<long[]> queue=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a->a[0]));queue.offer(new long[]{0,start});while(!queue.isEmpty()){long[] state=queue.poll();int node=(int)state[1];if(state[0]!=distance[node])continue;for(long[] edge:graph[node])if(state[0]+edge[1]<distance[(int)edge[0]]){distance[(int)edge[0]]=state[0]+edge[1];queue.offer(new long[]{distance[(int)edge[0]],edge[0]});}}return distance;}public long minimumWeight(int n,int[][] edges,int src1,int src2,int dest){List<long[]>[] graph=new List[n],reverse=new List[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++){graph[i]=new ArrayList<>();reverse[i]=new ArrayList<>();}for(int[] edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].add(new long[]{edge[1],edge[2]});reverse[edge[1]].add(new long[]{edge[0],edge[2]});}long[] first=dijkstra(src1,graph),second=dijkstra(src2,graph),suffix=dijkstra(dest,reverse);long answer=Long.MAX_VALUE;for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(first[i]!=Long.MAX_VALUE&&second[i]!=Long.MAX_VALUE&&suffix[i]!=Long.MAX_VALUE)answer=Math.min(answer,first[i]+second[i]+suffix[i]);return answer==Long.MAX_VALUE?-1:answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun dijkstra(start:Int,graph:Array<MutableList<LongArray>>):LongArray{val distance=LongArray(graph.size){Long.MAX_VALUE};distance[start]=0;val queue=java.util.PriorityQueue<LongArray>(compareBy{it[0]});queue.add(longArrayOf(0,start.toLong()));while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val state=queue.remove();val node=state[1].toInt();if(state[0]!=distance[node])continue;for(edge in graph[node])if(state[0]+edge[1]<distance[edge[0].toInt()]){distance[edge[0].toInt()]=state[0]+edge[1];queue.add(longArrayOf(distance[edge[0].toInt()],edge[0]))}};return distance};fun minimumWeight(n:Int,edges:Array<IntArray>,src1:Int,src2:Int,dest:Int):Long{val graph=Array(n){mutableListOf<LongArray>()};val reverse=Array(n){mutableListOf<LongArray>()};for(edge in edges){graph[edge[0]].add(longArrayOf(edge[1].toLong(),edge[2].toLong()));reverse[edge[1]].add(longArrayOf(edge[0].toLong(),edge[2].toLong()))};val first=dijkstra(src1,graph);val second=dijkstra(src2,graph);val suffix=dijkstra(dest,reverse);var answer=Long.MAX_VALUE;for(i in 0 until n)if(first[i]!=Long.MAX_VALUE&&second[i]!=Long.MAX_VALUE&&suffix[i]!=Long.MAX_VALUE)answer=minOf(answer,first[i]+second[i]+suffix[i]);return if(answer==Long.MAX_VALUE)-1 else answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { using Edge=pair<int,int>;vector<long long> dijkstra(int start,vector<vector<Edge>>& graph){vector<long long> distance(graph.size(),LLONG_MAX);distance[start]=0;priority_queue<pair<long long,int>,vector<pair<long long,int>>,greater<pair<long long,int>>> queue;queue.push({0,start});while(!queue.empty()){auto [cost,node]=queue.top();queue.pop();if(cost!=distance[node])continue;for(auto [next,weight]:graph[node])if(cost+weight<distance[next]){distance[next]=cost+weight;queue.push({distance[next],next});}}return distance;}public:long long minimumWeight(int n,vector<vector<int>>& edges,int src1,int src2,int dest){vector<vector<Edge>> graph(n),reverse(n);for(auto& edge:edges){graph[edge[0]].push_back({edge[1],edge[2]});reverse[edge[1]].push_back({edge[0],edge[2]});}auto first=dijkstra(src1,graph),second=dijkstra(src2,graph),suffix=dijkstra(dest,reverse);long long answer=LLONG_MAX;for(int i=0;i<n;++i)if(first[i]!=LLONG_MAX&&second[i]!=LLONG_MAX&&suffix[i]!=LLONG_MAX)answer=min(answer,first[i]+second[i]+suffix[i]);return answer==LLONG_MAX?-1:answer;} };
